name: Paid Social Low-Intent Traffic Surge
description: Starting 2026-09-12, an aggressive paid social advertising campaign tripes new user signups from channel 'paid_social', but these users have extremely low intent, high bounce rates, and negligible order conversion (~1% vs baseline 8%).
ground_truth_cause: Paid acquisition team launched low-intent ad campaigns on social media. Overall signup volume surges, causing aggregate conversion rate and average engagement per user to plunge despite healthy core product.

expected_observable_effects.users: Surge in new signups with acquisition_channel='paid_social' from Sept 12 onwards
expected_observable_effects.events: Paid social users generate fewer pageviews per session (1-2 pages, high bounce)
expected_observable_effects.orders: Overall conversion drops, but segmented by channel, organic/direct/search remain steady
expected_observable_effects.daily_product_metrics: New signups up significantly; average revenue per user down
